claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: Witness could not read any brand or model text on the console in either photo; cannot confirm PS5 slim identity.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo shows screws, seals, or internal casing condition.
Requires a power-on/boot test or thermal history, not visible in static photos.
No close-up of rear/side ports or a connected-device test shown.
Both photos show only a single controller leaning against the console, not multiple pads.
No photo of any receipt or proof of purchase document.

risks.risk: Console brand/model may not actually be PS5 slim
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the console's rear/bottom label or logo showing model number
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded white console, not as a confirmed PS5 slim

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have internal faults (disk drive, fan, overheating history)
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, reaching the home screen, and running briefly under load

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, extra controller, games)
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory bundle laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-and-single-controller only, no cables or extras

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage on sides/back not shown
risks.proof: Photos of all sides, back, and top of the console
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible unseen scratches/dents

risks.risk: Storage capacity and firmware/software state unknown
risks.proof: Photo of system settings/storage screen or box label showing capacity
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest common storage tier

risks.risk: Receipt authenticity and whether it confers any warranty
risks.proof: Clear photo of the actual UK receipt with date and serial match
risks.if_unproven: priced with no warranty value added

proof_requests: Close-up of console rear/bottom showing brand, model number, and serial
Boot-up video showing home screen and brief gameplay/load test
Photo of full accessory bundle: cables, extra controllers, games
Photos of all exterior sides including back and top
Clear photo of the UK receipt
response.reason: The witness confirms a home game console with one controller, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified-model, unverified-condition unit pending the listed proofs.
